content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Homebuilder selling houses to buyers; it does not operate rentable storage facilities, so the business model differs."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Office building REIT leasing to corporate and government tenants; different property type and tenant base."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Supermarket and fuel retailer selling groceries to households; not a storage rental business."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Bowling and entertainment centers selling play time and food; no overlap with storage unit rental."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Logistics warehouse REIT leasing to businesses; real estate like the target, but a different property type and customer."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Propane and fuel oil distributor delivering by truck to homes and businesses; different business entirely."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Hotel owner selling overnight rooms to travelers; hospitality model with no storage rental."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Homebuilder selling finished homes to consumers; different business from renting storage space."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Owns a hotel and apartment complexes plus securities; diversified and not focused on self-storage."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Land developer with hotels, clubs and timber in Florida; diversified real estate and hospitality, not storage."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Uniform and facility-supply rental to businesses via routes; a B2B service model unlike consumer storage rental."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Rent-to-own retailer selling furniture and electronics to consumers; lease-based but a different product and model."}]}
